data.one_liner: In-app localization package supporting map data or JSON assets with runtime language switching.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to add in-app localization using either in-memory Map data or JSON asset files. It provides methods to initialize languages, translate keys, format strings with arguments, and change locales at runtime.
use_when: You want to manage app translations using in-memory Dart maps or flat JSON assets.
You need dynamic runtime language switching backed by a ChangeNotifier.
avoid_when: You require code generation for type-safe translation keys.
Your translation JSON files require nested objects, arrays, or non-string values.
strengths: Supports both Map data and JSON asset files as sources.
Persists selected locales automatically using shared_preferences.
Provides built-in text formatting and native language name lookups.
weaknesses: JSON translation files must be strictly flat objects containing only string values.
No compile-time key checking or code generation.
data.setup_notes: Call WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized() and FlutterLocalization.instance.ensureInitialized() in main, then initialize the localization instance in initState.
